cassie: PR #3618 (websocket streaming quickstart + reconnect examples) is blocked: docs-preview CI failed and reviewer asked for runtime clarification about websocket keep-alive, server pings, and whether SDK reconnections can resume a stream. Tagging @omar and @jihoon for runtime/SDK behavior.

omar: Which snippet/line is failing the preview? Link?

cassie: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/3618 -- preview shows a 403 when trying to fetch runtime metadata during the build. The reviewer also asked whether a reconnect will replay the request or resume mid-stream and whether an idempotency key affects that.

ci-bot: docs-preview job #636 failed: error fetching runtime metadata (403). Logs: /builds/3618/logs/636.

jihoon: SDK quick note: Our JS SDK supports websocket streaming with auto-reconnect for transient network drops. By default it will attempt one reconnect and will not automatically replay non-idempotent requests. If the original request included an x-idempotency-key, SDK can attempt a safe replay on reconnect (subject to server-side idempotency policy). We expose options: `keepAliveIntervalMs` (default 45000) to send client pings, and `maxReconnectAttempts` (default 1).

omar: Runtime: server sends periodic ping frames every 45s on websocket streams to keep connections alive. We don't enforce a long-lived server-side idle timeout, but upstream load-balancers/proxies may drop idle connections after ~120s. Important: the runtime does not support mid-stream continuation/byte-range resume; reconnection will either replay the request from start (if idempotency key present and safe to replay) or surface an error. We do not silently stitch partial streams together.

cassie: Good, so docs should be explicit: 1) show default keep-alive/ping behavior (45s), 2) say proxies may still close after ~120s so recommend client-side pings and reconnection logic, 3) clarify that mid-stream resume is not supported and replay requires idempotency key. Also we should show a code example setting `idempotencyKey` and `keepAliveIntervalMs`.

jihoon: Example snippet to use in the PR: ```js
// set idempotency key and keepalive for websocket streaming
const client = new RwdClient({ apiKey: process.env.RWD_KEY })
await client.stream({
  model: 'rwd-stream-1',
  input: 'analyze this long input',
  idempotencyKey: 'user-order-12345',
  keepAliveIntervalMs: 45000,
  maxReconnectAttempts: 1
})
```

cassie: Also immediate blocker: preview 403. I'll replace the live runtime metadata call in the quickstart with a small preview stub `const meta = { env: 'PREVIEW' } // preview-only` to avoid hitting protected endpoints. That should get the preview green quickly.

omar: Runtime confirms no server-side resume; wording looks good. Approve the snippet suggestions. Ops should still update preview SA, but the stub is fine for now.
